kjv: [It is of] the LORD's mercies that we are not consumed
mine: The steadfast love of Yahweh never ceases
note: MT ki lo'-tamnu "that we are not consumed"; the Targum and Syriac read tammu "they have not ceased", parallel to "his mercies never come to an end". I follow the latter.

kjv: Give them (the enemies) sorrow of heart
mine: You (Yahweh) will give them (the enemies) dullness of heart
note: Hebrew meginnat-leb (hapax) is literally "a covering of the heart", i.e. obstinacy or dullness of mind; "sorrow" is a guess.
